The Wheel of Time turns and Ages come and pass, leaving only memories which become legend. Legend fades to myth, and even myth is long forgotten when the age that gave its birth comes again. In one Age called the Third Age by some, an Age not yet come, an Age long past,Lantean blasted with ''Callandor'' the White Tower to little grey pebbles. The blasting was not the beginning. There are neither beginnings, nor ending to the turning of the Wheel of Time. But it was ''a'' beginning.



Hi, my name is Lantean, after the Ancients of Stargate. I'm an avid reader of the Wheel of Time, and generally knock over a book in 5-6 hours, 4 if it is Path of Daggers.
